BENIGN.description: Legitimate enterprise communications including web browsing, database queries, and email traffic.
BENIGN.mitigation: Continuous baseline monitoring and traffic anomaly detection.

PortScan.description: Adversary probes remote systems across IP addresses and port ranges to discover active services and vulnerabilities.
PortScan.mitigation: Stateful firewall rate-limiting, egress filtering, port-knocking, and immediate intrusion alert generation.

Brute Force.description: Automated repetitive login attempts against FTP (FTP-Patator) or SSH (SSH-Patator) endpoints.
Brute Force.mitigation: Strict account lockout thresholds, mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA), fail2ban host-level daemon.

DoS.description: Denial of Service attacks utilizing application exhaustion (Slowloris, Slowhttptest, DoS Hulk, GoldenEye) to degrade server responsiveness.
DoS.mitigation: Connection timeout tuning, request header size restrictions, rate limiting per source IP.

DDoS.description: Distributed high-volume volumetric flooding intended to overwhelm network infrastructure and perimeter firewalls.
DDoS.mitigation: BGP Anycast routing, upstream cloud scrubbing centers (e.g., Cloudflare, Akamai), upstream ISP blackholing.

Web Attack.description: Exploitation of web vulnerabilities including SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), and administrative login bypass.
Web Attack.mitigation: Web Application Firewall (WAF) deployment, parameterized SQL queries, secure coding guidelines (OWASP Top 10).

Botnet.description: Compromised hosts beaconing out to external command and control servers (ARES botnet) to receive adversary instructions.
Botnet.mitigation: DNS sinkholing, TLS interception & certificate pinning verification, dynamic threat intelligence feed enforcement.

Infiltration.description: Adversary exploiting vulnerable network services or secondary internal payloads following perimeter breach.
Infiltration.mitigation: Zero Trust network architecture, micro-segmentation, rapid host-level CVE patching.

Heartbleed.description: Exploitation of OpenSSL TLS heartbeat extension buffer over-read (CVE-2014-0160) leaking private server memory contents.
Heartbleed.mitigation: Upgrade OpenSSL to patched versions, immediately revoke and re-issue all SSL/TLS private certificates.
